{{No footnotes|date=July 2023}}
'''Sippanondha Ketudat''' ({{langx|th|สิปปนนท์ เกตุทัต}}, {{RTGS|''Sippanon Ketthat''}}, {{IPA|th|sìp.pā.nōn kèːt.tʰát|pron}}; 23 February 1931 – 16 July 2006) was a Thai nuclear physicist, educationist and technocrat. He was a professor at [[Chulalongkorn University]], and served as Secretary-General of the [[Office of the National Education Commission]], [[Minister of Education (Thailand)|Minister of Education]] and [[Minister of Industry (Thailand)|Minister of Industry]]. He held seats on several university councils, including multiple chairmanships, and was an honorary fellow of the [[Royal Society of Thailand]].
